resources.string: Lists subscribed channels without an upload for over a year, with the age of their last upload. Tick and unsubscribe, with undo.
Under an opened description the links are grouped: timestamps, channels, videos, external links. Ad and affiliate links are marked and folded, also in the text.
In Formen the video takes the bar\'s width, corners and colour while you drag it down and merges into it; the page fades out softly.
